diagram_previews.alt: Left: rhombus ABCD with centre O, both diagonals, and perpendiculars from O to the four sides (foot H on AB), cutting it into eight right triangles, four blue ones at the ends A and C of the long diagonal and four orange ones at the ends B and D. An arrow points right to two smaller rhombuses of the same shape: one made of the four blue triangles (side c) and a smaller one made of the four orange triangles (side s).

difficulty_rationale: The construction rests on one meaningful insight: the altitude to the hypotenuse splits each quarter-triangle into two triangles similar to it with ratios c and s, which then rebuild scaled rhombi.
